scope_i18n.en: Selected official finding-aid entries only: Box18/folder13.8 notes and1949 article; Box21/folder15.2 undated notes. Original report contents and priority remain unverified.

references.label: Cleve Moler (1996), The Thomas Algorithm, NA Digest96(09),4March
references.scope: Moler reports the attribution and transcribes a1949 Thomas report citation via Ames1977,p52, plus a Bruce et al.1953 lead. The Ames and Bruce original pages were not inspected. This is a history lead, not Thomas's original derivation.

scope_i18n.ja: 署名付き1996年通信の該当節を確認。Ames1977のp52を介したThomas1949報告の書誌とBruceほか1953への手掛かり。Ames/Bruceの実ページとThomas原報は未読。
scope_i18n.en: Read the signed1996 correspondence section; Ames1977,p52 and Bruce et al.1953 remain uninspected leads. Thomas1949 original unread.

public_summary.ja: Thomas法は三重対角消去。1949年原報は未読で、公式収蔵目録とMolerの1996年通信から書誌を追跡しています。Crank–Nicolsonと多重格子の文献は関連章の背景資料で、Thomas原報やその再録ではありません。
public_summary.en: Thomas is tridiagonal elimination. Its1949 original remains unread; an official archival finding aid and Moler's signed1996 correspondence provide bibliographic leads. Crank–Nicolson and multigrid references are related chapter context, not Thomas originals or reprints.
